extensionDescription.message: Fast, lightweight, privacy-first speed and playback control for HTML5 video and audio.

pageUnavailableTitle.message: FleetFoot Engine can't work on this page.

pageUnavailableHint.message: Browser pages and extension stores don't allow extensions.

noAnswerHint.message: It may be busy or it has just changed. Try again.

noMediaTitle.message: No video or audio on this page.

noMediaHint.message: A player inside a frame from another site can't be reached from here.

framedTitle.message: The player is in a frame from $SITE$.
framedTitle.description: Popup: no player here, but a frame from another site is on screen; $SITE$ is that site, e.g. «vixcloud.co».

framedHint.message: To reach it, the browser asks for access to that site; from then on FleetFoot Engine starts there by itself.
framedHint.description: Popup, under framedTitle: allowing the site lets the extension reach the frame, and it then starts there by itself.

framedAllowSite.description: Popup button: asks the browser for access to that one site.

framedAllowAll.description: Popup button: asks the browser for access to every site (as «Always, on every site» in the options).

seekBack.description: Accessible name; the duration comes with its unit («5 seconds»).

seekForward.description: Accessible name; the duration comes with its unit («5 seconds»).

loopHelpLabel.description: Accessible name of the info button next to the loop.

loopHelp.message: Repeats one stretch over and over, to rewatch or study it.
loopHelp.description: Popover explaining the A–B loop: what it is for.

loopHelpSteps.message: Press A where it starts, B where it ends, then Loop.
loopHelpSteps.description: Popover explaining the A–B loop: how to set it.

loopHelpClear.description: Last line of the loop help; × is the clear button.

copyFailed.message: The timestamp could not be copied.

playerVideo.description: Short name of a video player, numbered in order of discovery.

playerPlaying.description: Detail of a player that is playing now.

playerEmbedded.description: Detail of a player inside a frame of the page; $SITE$ is that frame's site.

playerEmbeddedUnknown.description: Detail of a player inside a frame of the page that has no site.

policySmart.message: Restore it on the next video (recommended)

policyLock.message: Restore it at once, every time

noticeContested.message: Another extension or the page keeps changing the speed of this player. To avoid a tug of war, FleetFoot Engine has stopped restoring it.

noticeContestedChoose.description: Popup link after the LOCK yielded notice: opens the option.

noticeExtremeRate.message: At this speed the browser may mute or distort the audio.

noticeLive.message: This is live, so you can't seek or see the time left.

errorNoPlayer.message: The player is no longer on the page.

errorPitchUnsupported.message: This player can't keep voices natural.

errorNoPreviousRate.message: There is no previous speed yet.

errorNotSeekable.message: This media can't be moved through right now.

errorNotLoopable.message: A loop needs media with a known length.

errorPipUnavailable.message: Picture-in-picture isn't available for this player.

errorPipRejected.message: The browser refused picture-in-picture. Use the button on the overlay or a shortcut on the page.

speedGroupRates.description: Options, Speed section: heading of the user's own speeds (presets, step, favorite and hold speeds).

speedGroupRestore.description: Options, Speed section: heading of what happens when a site changes the speed.

speedGroupPlayers.description: Options, Speed section: heading of which players a speed applies to.

presetsHelp.message: Up to 12 speeds separated by spaces, for example 1 1.5 2.

presetsInvalid.message: Write from 1 to $MAX$ speeds, separated by spaces.

holdField.message: Speed while a key is held

policyField.message: If the site changes the speed

policyFollowHelp.message: Your speed is applied once. Example: the next episode starts at 1× and stays at 1×.

policySmartHelp.message: Example: the next episode starts at 1×, and your speed comes back. If the site changes the speed while you watch, it stays as the site set it until the next video.

policyLockHelp.message: Example: while you watch, the site puts 1× back, and an instant later your speed is back. For sites that keep resetting the speed.

pitchField.message: Natural voice when the speed changes

skipSilenceField.description: Name of Skip Silence: options switch, site profile field, popup button.

skipSilenceHelp.message: During pauses the player switches to the silence speed and goes back to yours as soon as the sound returns. The sound is heard only on your device, never recorded or sent.
skipSilenceHelp.description: What Skip Silence does and that the sound stays on the device: options help, popup card.

skipSilenceSettings.description: Link in the popup card of Skip Silence, to its place on the options page.

silenceModeField.description: Options legend: how readily a pause counts as a silence.

silenceConservative.description: Options choice: only long, quiet pauses count.

silenceNormal.description: Options choice, the default: pauses between sentences count too.

silenceAggressive.message: Every pause, even with some background noise
silenceAggressive.description: Options choice: every pause counts, even with background noise.

silenceRateField.description: Options field: the speed a silence plays at.

noticeSkipSilenceWaiting.message: Skip silences starts with your first click on the page.
noticeSkipSilenceWaiting.description: Notice: the browser starts audio only after a click on the page.

noticeSkipSilenceUnavailable.message: Skip silences isn't available on this media.
noticeSkipSilenceUnavailable.description: Notice: the browser does not let the extension hear this media.

seekStepInvalid.message: Write a whole number of seconds from $MIN$ to $MAX$.

pageShortcutsHelp.message: They work after you open FleetFoot Engine on the page, and never while you type in a field.

keyRemove.description: Button label: the button shows only a cross.

browserShortcutsHelp.message: Shortcuts that work on every page are assigned in the browser's extension shortcut settings.

overlayHelp.message: A small bar that appears while the pointer is on the player.

overlayResetPosition.message: Put the overlay back in its corner

contextMenuField.message: Speed menu when you right-click a video or audio

contextMenuHelp.message: It appears only on video and audio.

restoreConfirm.message: Click again to restore every default

timeLeftAt.description: Remaining time at the current speed.

savedHours.description: Time saved: hours then minutes, each already with its unit («12 h», «34 min»).

savedHelp.message: Time you did not have to spend, because FleetFoot Engine played your videos and audio faster. Kept only on this device, as one total.

textSizeField.description: Options, Appearance: label of the choice of text size for this page, from 100% to 200%.

textSizeHelp.message: Enlarges the text and controls of this page.

themeSlate.description: Theme: dimmed blue-grey, easy on the eyes.

themeSepia.description: Theme: dimmed warm brown, easy on the eyes.

themeSage.description: Theme: dimmed green, easy on the eyes.

pitchHelpShort.description: Popup subtitle of the natural voice switch.

privacyBadge.description: Badge; the same words in every language.

privacyBadgeSub.message: Zero telemetry · No accounts · Local-only settings

privacyStatement.message: This extension does not send your browsing activity anywhere.
privacyStatement.description: Privacy section: the promise about browsing activity.

verifySource.message: Don't trust us. Read the source.
verifySource.description: Privacy section: the invitation to read the source, before its link.

supportQuestion.description: Popup footer question before the support link.

supportSaved.description: Popup footer question before the support link, once the time saved reaches an hour; whole hours, with the unit («12 h»).

reviewStore.description: Accessible name of the heart at the top of the popup, which opens this extension's page in the store it was installed from, to leave a review.

memoryNoneHelp.message: Every page starts at its own speed.

memoryGlobalHelp.message: The last speed you chose is used everywhere. Only the number is kept.

memorySiteHelp.message: Each site keeps its own speed and, if you like, its own settings. Only the site's name is kept, never what you watch.

profilesEmpty.message: No sites yet. Change the speed on a site and it will show up here.

profileSpeed.message: Speed (leave empty for the site's own)

profileGeneralValue.description: Option or placeholder: no value of its own on this site; the value it takes from the general settings in brackets.

policyFollowShort.description: Short name of a rate policy, inside «General (…)».

policySmartShort.description: Short name of a rate policy, inside «General (…)».

policyLockShort.description: Short name of a rate policy, inside «General (…)».

fightField.message: If the site changes it back at once
fightField.description: Options legend: what LOCK does when a page answers every restore at once.

fightYield.message: Let it go and tell me (recommended)

fightBraked.message: Keep restoring it, with a brake
fightBraked.description: LOCK fight answer: keep imposing, bounded.

fightUnbraked.description: LOCK fight answer: keep imposing, unbounded.

fightHelpLabel.description: Accessible name of the info button next to the LOCK fight choices.

fightYieldHelp.message: FleetFoot Engine stops restoring the speed on that player and tells you in the popup.

fightBrakedHelp.message: It keeps restoring your speed without the site noticing, within a limit that keeps the cost low. The site's player may show a speed that isn't the real one.

fightUnbrakedHelp.message: The same, with no limit. On some sites it can keep a whole processor core busy, using more power and draining the battery faster.
fightUnbrakedHelp.description: Info popover, third answer and its risk.

accessOnClickHelp.message: It works on a tab after you click its icon, use a shortcut or the right-click menu. It has access to no site.

accessSelected.message: Always, on the sites you choose

accessSelectedHelp.message: It starts by itself on those sites, with the shortcuts ready.

accessAllHelp.message: Your browser asks for access to every site. FleetFoot Engine only looks for video and audio. It never reads pages and never sends anything.

accessDeclined.message: The browser didn't give access, so nothing changed.

accessFiles.message: Videos opened from your computer aren't covered by these choices; to use FleetFoot Engine on them, click its icon.

sitesExcludedHelp.message: On these sites it never starts by itself; you can still call it with a click.

siteHelp.message: A name like example.com, or the address of one of its pages.

siteInvalid.message: This is not a site. Write it like example.com.

excludedFull.message: You can exclude up to $MAX$ sites.

privacyWhereOnClick.message: Where it works: only when you call it
privacyWhereOnClick.description: Where FleetFoot Engine runs today: one whole sentence per access mode.

privacyWhereSelected.message: Where it works: always, on the sites you choose
privacyWhereSelected.description: Where FleetFoot Engine runs today: one whole sentence per access mode.

privacyWhereAll.message: Where it works: always, on every site
privacyWhereAll.description: Where FleetFoot Engine runs today: one whole sentence per access mode.

privacyAccessChange.description: Link to the site access section.

backupHelp.message: A file with your settings and the sites you saved, to keep or to bring to another browser. It stays where you put it.

exportFailed.message: The settings could not be exported.

importIgnored.message: Values left out because they are not valid: $COUNT$

importReplace.message: They take the place of the current ones. Sites that are not in the file stay as they are.

importFailed.message: The settings could not be imported.

importTooLarge.message: This file is too large to be a copy of the settings.

importNotJson.message: This file cannot be read as a copy of the settings.

importNotBackup.message: This file is not a copy of FleetFoot Engine settings.

importNewer.message: This copy comes from a newer FleetFoot Engine. Update it, then import again.

deleteAllHelp.message: Deletes the settings, the sites you saved and the time saved. Site permissions stay; you can remove them under $SECTION$.
deleteAllHelp.description: Help; the substitution is the site access section title.

deletedAll.message: Everything FleetFoot Engine kept on this device is deleted.

aboutLicense.description: Licence summary; the licence text decides.

welcomeSpeedHelp.message: One tap on the star in the popup gives you this speed. From 0.10 to 16.00.

welcomeDone.description: First-run page button that closes it.

welcomeAllSettings.description: First-run page link to the options page.
